title: About
text:
I am building this publication to explore mathematics, physics, and scientific computing through careful research and clear explanations.
My interests include mathematical analysis, abstract algebra, quantum mechanics, quantum cryptography, and computational modelling.
The aim is to make technical ideas accessible without sacrificing mathematical precision.

title: Mathematics meets the real world
text:
Welcome to Scientific Notes, an independent publication exploring the ideas, equations, and computational experiments behind mathematics and physics.
I write about concepts that deserve more than a formula: how they work, why they matter, and what we can discover by examining them carefully.
